subject: Future Tech
title: Reusable Rockets Changed Everything
description: A 60-second lesson on Reusable Rockets Changed Everything.

hook.text: Before SpaceX, every rocket was used once and thrown into the ocean. That's like junking a plane after one flight.

buildup.text: SpaceX landed its first Falcon 9 booster in December 2015. Engineers cheered as it touched down on a concrete pad.

discovery.text: Reusing boosters dropped the cost per launch from $200 million to under $30 million, a tenfold improvement.

twist.text: Starship aims to be fully reusable, both stages. If it works, launch costs could fall to a few million dollars.

climax.text: Cheap launches make space stations, Moon bases, and Mars missions economically possible for the first time.

punchline.text: Reuse made space affordable for everyone.

quiz.question: When did SpaceX first land a Falcon 9 booster?
